name: yearqtr
title: An Index Class for Quarterly Data

origin.description: Snap a numeric year fraction onto quarter boundaries.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric vector interpreted as a year plus a fraction of a year.

origin.details: yearqtr stores the year plus 0 for quarter 1, 1/4 for quarter 2, 1/2 for quarter 3, and 3/4 for quarter 4, the same encoding as a quarterly ts. The stored value is floor(4 * x + 0.001) / 4.
origin.value: A numeric vector of class yearqtr.
origin.example:
x <- yearqtr(2000 + (0:7)/4)
cat(paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x)), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
cat(paste(format(x), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Snap a numeric year fraction onto quarter boundaries.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A number or a sequence of numbers, read as a year plus a fraction of a year.

translation.details: The result is a Yearqtr. Its value array is floor(4 * x + 0.001) / 4 in float64. Quarter 1 of 2000 is 2000 and quarter 2 is 2000.25.
translation.value: A Yearqtr whose value array is the snapped year fraction.
translation.example:
from zoo.yearqtr import format_yearqtr, yearqtr
import numpy as np
x = yearqtr(2000 + np.arange(8) / 4)
print(" ".join(format(v, ".17g") for v in x.value))
print(" ".join(format_yearqtr(x)))
